verdict.rationale: Ramp's programmatic surface is broad. The Developer API covers transactions, bills (POST /bills with multiple payment methods), virtual cards via the Vault API, custom records, spend controls and AI usage, all under resource-level OAuth scopes. The open-source CLI spans 12 resources, including approvals, reimbursements, travel, receipts and funds, and MCP adds reads, approvals and purchases. Ramp never claims full UI parity, and its own docs name gaps: bill approvals are not available via MCP (the UI or the Approvals API is required), and creating an API app requires the UI's Company → Developer page. Missing for 10: an explicit or verified API/UI parity claim, API coverage of UI features like procurement RFx and travel booking/rebooking, API-based app provisioning, and independent hands-on corroboration.
